title: Priority Fix Tenant Repairs
subtitle: Making the repair journey easier to understand—from first report to completion.
summary: A tenant-focused repair app with account access, issue reporting with video attachments, repair-status tracking and push notification support.
overview: The supplied Priority Fix feature brief identifies four existing app capabilities: tenant access, repair requests, repair tracking and push notifications. It also lists four proposed modules. This case study keeps those two sets completely separate.
focus: An app experience organized around the tenant's essential questions: How do I report a problem? What is happening next? Who is visiting? Has the repair been completed?
caveat: The uploaded file is a short feature list, not source-code evidence or a runtime audit. No repository, implementation dates, individual contributions, screenshots, usage metrics or production outcome evidence were provided. The four requested modules are proposals only.

highlights.title: Tenant access
highlights.body: The brief lists sign-up, sign-in, terms acceptance and profile editing.

highlights.title: Report an issue
highlights.body: Tenants can report problems, attach videos and view request details.

highlights.title: Track a repair
highlights.body: Repair status, contractor or visit information and completion confirmation are listed.

highlights.title: Stay informed
highlights.body: The brief includes push-notification support, without specifying event triggers.

main.name: Tenant access
main.detail: Sign up or sign in, accept terms and maintain profile details.

main.name: Report an issue
main.detail: Create a repair request and attach a supporting video.

main.name: Check progress
main.detail: Review status plus contractor and visit information.

main.name: Confirm completion
main.detail: The tenant can confirm that the repair has been completed.
